relation.rationale: The readings differ in the chapter/section number (LXIX vs 58), which constitutes a difference in wording/lexical content rather than just orthography or punctuation.
The difference is the presence of the umlaut (hoͤllen vs hellen), which is a graphic variation of the same word form.
Difference in the spelling of the preposition (w- vs v-), same grammatical form.
The readings differ between the possessive pronoun 'ſeine' (his) and the genitive demonstrative 'deſſe' (of that/his), which are distinct words.
